stem: On a certain dry road, the braking distance \(d\), in meters, of a car traveling at \(v\) kilometers per hour is modeled by \(d = \frac{v^{2}}{160}\). According to the model, at what speed, in kilometers per hour, does a car have a braking distance of 40 meters?
solution: Multiply by \(160\): \(v^{2} = 6{,}400\). Speed is positive, so \(v = 80\).
verify:
v = symbols('v', positive=True)
sol = solve(Eq(40, v**2/160), v)
assert sol == [80]
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == sol
